run_mamba_model_evaluation: run the Mamba model evaluation pipeline using a config file and OmegaConf CLI arguments
launch_eval_with_args: launch evaluation on a consolidated Mamba checkpoint using EvalArgs configuration and lm_eval harness
evaluate_model_on_validation_set: evaluate a Mamba model on a validation dataset using the eval_on_val function with generator
consolidate_and_load_mamba_checkpoint: consolidate Mamba model checkpoints and load the model with tokenizer for evaluation
log_evaluation_metrics_to_jsonl: log evaluation and validation metrics to JSONL files with timestamps and global step info
